content:
To find the physical dimension of power, we start with its definition as energy divided by time:
$$\text{Power} = \frac{\text{Energy}}{\text{Time}}$$

First, we determine the dimensions of Energy (E). Energy has the same dimensions as Work, which is defined as Force multiplied by distance (Length):
$$\text{Work} = \text{Force} \times \text{Length}$$

Force is defined by Newton's Second Law as Mass multiplied by acceleration:
$$\text{Force} = \text{Mass} \times \text{Acceleration}$$

Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity over time, and velocity is length divided by time:
$$\text{Acceleration} = \frac{\text{Length}}{\text{Time}^2}$$

Combining these, we get the dimension for Force:
$$\text{Force} = \text{Mass} \times \frac{\text{Length}}{\text{Time}^2}$$

Now, substitute the dimension of Force back into the expression for Energy:
$$\text{Energy} = \left(\text{Mass} \times \frac{\text{Length}}{\text{Time}^2}\right) \times \text{Length} = \frac{\text{Mass} \times \text{Length}^2}{\text{Time}^2}$$

Finally, we find the dimension of Power by dividing Energy by Time:
$$\text{Power} = \frac{\text{Energy}}{\text{Time}} = \frac{\text{Mass} \times \text{Length}^2 / \text{Time}^2}{\text{Time}} = \frac{\text{Mass} \times \text{Length}^2}{\text{Time}^3}$$

<ANSWER>Mass * Length^2 / Time^3</ANSWER>
reasoning:
*   Quantity: Power (P)
    *   Definition: Energy (E) divided by Time (t)
    *   Inputs: E = energy, t = time

    *   Energy is the capacity to do work.
    *   Work = Force × Distance
    *   Force = Mass × Acceleration
    *   Acceleration = Velocity / Time = (Length / Time) / Time = Length / Time²
    *   So, Force = Mass * Length / Time²
    *   And Energy = Work = Force * Length = (Mass * Length / Time²) * Length = Mass * Length² / Time²

    *   Power = Energy / Time
    *   Dimensions of Power = (Mass * Length² / Time²) / Time
    *   Dimensions of Power = Mass * Length² / Time³

    *   Base dimensions: Mass, Length, Time, Temperature, Current, Amount, Luminosity.
    *   Power's dimension is Mass * Length^2 / Time^3.
